The '''Republic Privateer Service Corps''' was an organization that was established by [[Dorian Janarus]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
